name: Bebê
prompt: ONE ORIGINAL BABY Soulmonsters pre-evolution of supplied own CARAMEL DOG KNIGHT reference. Very simple tiny living DOG-FACED KITE, no humanoid body, armor, hands or legs. A small soft rounded DIAMOND of warm CARAMEL tensioned paper, lower half IVORY forming a very short gently protruding puppy muzzle with small dark nose; two little calm amber eyes and a tiny curious mouth. Exactly TWO triangular ear-flaps built into top sides, ONE perked outward, OTHER FLOPPED forward with a single fold. Ears not enormous. Two slim honey wood ribs trace diamond edges and join in a single toasted copper knot below face. ONE short caramel curled cord soul-rabiola from that knot with just ONE small indigo/ivory two-tone paper pennant. One little dark green leaf-shaped paper tab tucked against one ear as a subtle future family motif, no horn. Baby soft unthreatening expression, very few large forms, no fluffy fur tufts or repeated crease fragments. Full small creature centered on WHITE with ample margins. Clean precise 2D MANGA lines, flat caramel/ivory/indigo colors, ONE hard simple cel shadow, selective stepped contour, NOT glossy cartoon mascot, not realistic dog, no gradients, texture, scenery, text, jewelry, swords or armor. The adult reference determines family identity and clean finish only; do not depict adult face or helmet on small body.
story: Uma pipa-rosto curiosa descobre o vento; orelha caída e folha já anunciam a família.
review: Sem corpo ou membros, duas orelhas assimétricas, uma rabiola completa com um terminal bicolor. Há transições suaves leves nas áreas claras, sem render metálico.

name: Criança
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL CHILD stage Soulmonsters CARAMEL STREET DOG, the intermediate between the supplied own BABY living kite-face and future adult knight. One full three-quarter COMPLETE QUADRUPED puppy creature on WHITE with ample margins. Small compact cheerful but clever BRAZILIAN vira-lata caramelo, warm caramel body with short thick four legs, broad ivory seed-shaped paws and THREE small toe tips each, short natural cream dog muzzle, dark small nose, modest amber anime eyes (not huge glossy mascot eyes), ears one crooked upright and one flopped forward, head about one third total height. Natural DOG mouth, no humanoid face or helmet. Pose leaning forward curious with one front paw lifted slightly, smile subtle closed mouth not tongue out, no sword. Body is an anatomically integrated living KITE: broad ivory chest shaped like small tapered diamond PAPER MEMBRANE with TWO short honey wooden edge ribs tied by a tiny COPPER knot at throat, a SINGLE CARAMEL CHEVRON folded over top of chest, like beginning of future dragon-scale armor. Back formed from just three broad smooth caramel paper panels, not realistic furry dog wearing armor. Shoulder has ONE small asymmetric INDIGO folded-paper tab held by a tiny copper corner knot, not a big shield or full armor yet. ONE small DARK GREEN LEAF emblem at the tip of that shoulder tab repeats leaf on future knight. No greaves, no full armored limbs or shoulder wings. Elbows and ankles show small dark indigo fold accents where paper flexes, no joint machinery. ONE natural curved caramel tail with golden cord end and TWO short indigo/ivory paper pennants, full attachment and ends visible. Family colors warm caramel, ivory, deep indigo, small copper and green accents. Clean confident original 2D MANGA ink outlines, big flat colors and ONE sharply edged cel shadow per material, no airbrush gradient/metal glints/realistic fur/shaggy paper crumpling/scenery/text. Readable warm-hearted child with scrappy confidence, stable four-legged dog silhouette, signature ear asymmetry and tiny future protective chest plate. Reference adult supplies identity and palette only; do not dress puppy as a small knight. Baby reference supplies simplified kite face family continuity.
story: Ganha corpo quadrúpede, explora o bairro e aprende a se colocar na frente de quem precisa de proteção.
review: Quatro patas completas, orelha caída e erguida, peito de membrana com varetas, uma placa peitoral e pequena aba na ombreira com folha. Três grandes painéis dorsais, sem pelagem fragmentada. Rabiola com dois terminais.

name: Jovem
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL YOUNG adolescent quadrupedal Soulmonsters pre-evolution of the supplied CARAMEL DOG KNIGHT Caramund reference. Same clean 2D manga model-sheet finish, matte flat base colors and ONE hard cel shadow per material, no textures/reflections/gradients. Full three-quarter entire creature on WHITE, generous margins. It is now an unmistakable alert BRAZILIAN CARAMEL MIXED-BREED STREET DOG creature, NOT a human knight, not a German shepherd or husky, not a wolf or lion. Lanky athletic canine body with broad chest, tucked waist and FOUR complete natural canine legs, long slim paws with THREE short ivory claw tips each, one front paw raised a little as if intercepting danger, other three planted, head modest proportional. Warm caramel body built of broad smooth tensioned-paper planes with toasted ochre shadow, ivory short natural dog muzzle and chest, narrow amber focused manga eyes, dark small nose, TWO medium triangular ears: one upright skewed outward, other FLOPPED forward by one simple paper fold. No humanoid mouth, no animal helmet worn on head: this is actual dog face. Ivory brow fold and back-of-head taper anticipates adult dog visor. Structural KITE anatomy: wide curved ivory sternum membrane under TWO overlapping broad caramel CHEVRON SCALE plates, pale wooden bowed ribs visible at edges. Its LEFT shoulder (viewer right) has one large triangular swept-back kite-paper SHIELD MEMBRANE edged with warm wooden spars and a copper corner knot, with TWO caramel protective scale panels across upper portion. A single small DARK GREEN LEAF inset on the uppermost shoulder scale is family signature. Opposite shoulder compact and bare enough for movement. Dark INDIGO folded-paper sleeve sockets at shoulders/hips, broad ivory/caramel shin braces grow from the leg structure, not a generic plate suit for a normal animal. No tiny paper fur. Two short indigo/ivory mantle strips tucked to shoulder frame and sweeping behind barrel like half-developed adult mantle. ONE warm caramel DOG TAIL curves from rump into a golden soul cord with TWO full indigo/ivory paper pennants, attachment legible. It is a neighborhood guardian beginning to develop dragon-resisting kite scales, no dragon head, horns or wings, no sword or weapons at this stage. Quiet proud loyal protective face, four-legged long reaching silhouette distinctly more mature than a puppy and structurally different from biped adult. 45 percent creature, 45 percent functional living kite paper/spar/knot anatomy, 10 percent crisp manga. Strong dark ink outlines, clean large flat color fields, no realistic fur, scratches, light effects, text, scenery or extra creatures.
story: Passa a interceptar ameaças com ombreira de pipa e proteção de escamas, preparando a postura do futuro cavaleiro.
review: Quatro pernas; uma pata dianteira elevada, demais apoiadas. Rosto canino pequeno, orelhas assimétricas, duas placas no peito e ombreira maior. A ombreira mostra três painéis em vez dos dois solicitados, preservando parentesco com adulto. Quantidade de unhas varia entre patas; padronizar em futura produção técnica. Rabiola completa com dois terminais.
